title: n8nkit config
description: Tuning + paths for the n8nkit toolkit. NO secrets — secrets stay in OS env / n8n credentials.

workflowRoot.description: Home of n8n projects on this machine. Guards + skills read this instead of hardcoding paths.

validationProfile.description: Default n8nctl validation profile. dev=CRITICAL, ci=CRITICAL+HIGH (default), strict=+MEDIUM.

n8nHostEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the n8n host URL (e.g. N8N_HOST).
